summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K reporting the weekly progress of the third tranche of its 2026 share buy-back programme announced 22 July 2026, running 23 July to 26 October 2026. During 17-21 August 2026, Equinor purchased 721,000 own shares at an average price of NOK 394.7557 per share, for a total transaction value of NOK 284.6 million. Accumulated purchases under the tranche total 2,928,004 shares at an average of NOK 384.9271. Following completion, Equinor holds 17,382,915 own shares, representing 0.73% of share capital including shares under the savings programme, or 0.27% excluding those. This routine periodic buy-back disclosure confirms an ongoing capital return programme. What to watch: continued execution pace and any tranche completion or extension announcements.
